pagerduty-bot: pd alert fired -> `pd:LATENCY_P95_EDGE` (severity: high) at 2026-02-18T14:03:19Z :rotating_light:
Alyssa (oncall): acked. seeing p95 bursts in eu-west-1 starting ~1868009950, auto-resolved then retriggered twice. no bulk 5xx spikes in logs so far.
Sam B: oncall-reply: I'm jumping in. any customer-facing reports?
Alyssa (oncall): none in zendesk. telemetry shows short tail spikes primarily for tiny requests (<=64 tokens). looks like router queuing on a small set of hosts.
Kevin R: checking infra side - autoscaler churn or recent node events?
Alyssa (oncall): trace snippet shows router->proxy queue time around 180-400ms on 3 hosts.
Alyssa (oncall): logs: ```
2026-02-18T14:03:21Z router-az2 debug queue_wait_ms=212 host=proxy-az2-11 req_id=abc123
2026-02-18T14:03:22Z router-az2 debug queue_wait_ms=347 host=proxy-az2-11 req_id=def456
```
Nikita: autoscaler looks healthy but kube events show short pod restart spike in az2 around 14:02:45.
Alyssa (oncall): no OOM lines in pod logs. investigating node-level metrics (cpu steal, network errs).
pagerduty-bot: Alert retriggered (duplicate) at 1868010002
Alyssa (oncall): I'm going to silence duplicate PD alerts for 10m to reduce noise while we triage — will keep escalation path open for criticals.
Kevin R: pulled dmesg from node-az2-07, kernel shows eth1 link flaps and interface resets during the window.
Alyssa (oncall): checked cloud provider status -> they reported transient networking jitter in eu-west at 14:02:50 UTC. matches our timing.
Sam B: that fits. if infra-tier jitter is the cause, customer impact likely minimal and transient. any rate surge?
Alyssa (oncall): rate steady. small-tail latency only, no error-budget burn. marking customer impact: none.
Nikita: creating a short runbook note: "region network jitter -> transient router queueing -> p95 tail spike". will file a follow-up to harden router backpressure and add cross-AZ retry logic for tiny requests.
Alyssa (oncall): updating PD incident with findings and applying 10m silence to duplicates. monitoring for 15m. handing postmortem to Kevin (infra-networking).
pagerduty-bot: Incident 2468 updated: status=acknowledged, note added by Alyssa (oncall)
Alyssa (oncall): incident auto-resolved (PagerDuty auto-clear) at 1868010150 — leaving thread open until postmortem ticket exists.
Kevin R: opened INFRA-3192. preliminary root cause: provider network jitter in az2 causing brief router queuebacks. mitigations: router soft-timeouts, cross-AZ affinity fallback, and more aggressive connection health checks. ETA: 3d to implement patch, 1wk validation.
Alyssa (oncall): thanks everyone. no customer impact, system steady now :white_check_mark:. will post summary in #eng-infra when INFRA-3192 has details.
